skill.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skill.description: Guides an AI coding assistant through finishing a completed development branch by verifying tests, presenting integration options, and handling cleanup.
skill.summary: Finish completed development branches with tests, merge or PR decisions, and safe cleanup.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

content.value_statement: Completing a feature branch often requires tests, merge decisions, and cleanup. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through safe branch finishing choices.
actual_capabilities: Prompts the assistant to verify project tests before branch integration.
Helps identify the likely base branch before merge or PR decisions.
Presents four completion paths: local merge, pull request, keep branch, or discard.
Defines Git and GitHub CLI steps for merge, PR creation, deletion, and worktree cleanup.
Requires explicit confirmation before destructive discard actions.
limitations: Does not replace project-specific release, review, or CI policies.
Assumes Git and, for pull requests, GitHub CLI are available and authenticated.
Commands include placeholders that the assistant must adapt and verify before execution.
Local merges and deletions can change repository state when approved by the user.

use_cases.title: Complete a Feature Branch
use_cases.description: A developer can ask the assistant to verify tests, choose an integration path, and clean up after the work is complete.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Pull Request
use_cases.description: A team member can push a finished branch and create a PR with a concise summary and test plan.

use_cases.title: Close Temporary Worktrees
use_cases.description: A maintainer can remove finished local branches and worktrees after merge or explicit discard confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Finish This Branch
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow after implementation is complete.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the finishing-a-development-branch skill. Verify tests, identify the base branch, then present the completion options before taking action.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Pull Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Contributor wants a PR after tests pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the finishing-a-development-branch skill to finish this work. If tests pass, help me push the branch and create a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Merge Locally and Clean Up
prompt_templates.scenario: Developer wants a local merge into the base branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the finishing-a-development-branch skill. Verify tests, confirm the base branch, merge locally if I choose that option, then verify tests again.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Completion Choices
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with branch, PR, and worktree decisions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the finishing-a-development-branch skill and explain the safest completion path for this repository after checking tests, branch state, and worktree status.

output_examples.input: The implementation is done. Help me finish this branch.
output: Tests are checked first and failures block merge or PR steps.
The assistant identifies or confirms the base branch.
The assistant presents merge, PR, keep, and discard options.

output_examples.input: Push this finished work and open a PR.
output: The assistant verifies tests before pushing.
The assistant prepares a PR title, summary, and test plan.
The local worktree is preserved unless cleanup is explicitly appropriate.

output_examples.input: Discard this branch after I confirm.
output: The assistant lists what will be deleted.
The assistant waits for exact typed confirmation.
The assistant deletes and cleans up only after confirmation.

best_practices: Run the project test suite before choosing any completion path.
Confirm destructive discard actions with exact typed consent.
Re-run tests after a local merge before deleting the feature branch.
anti_patterns: Merging or opening a PR while tests are failing.
Deleting a branch or worktree without explicit confirmation.
Assuming the base branch without checking repository history or asking the user.

faq.question: Does this skill run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to run the project test suite before presenting merge or PR options.

faq.question: Can it create pull requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides a GitHub CLI workflow for pushing the branch and creating a pull request.

faq.question: Does it delete branches?
faq.answer: It can guide branch deletion only after the user chooses discard and types the required confirmation.

faq.question: What happens if tests fail?
faq.answer: The skill tells the assistant to stop and show the failures before any merge or PR action.

faq.question: Does it support Git worktrees?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes worktree cleanup guidance for workflows where cleanup is appropriate.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when development work is complete and you need a structured Git integration decision.
